newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged at 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged at 2.5 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) on Friday left its key discount rate for August unchanged at a monthly 2.5 percent, an NBY official told Reuters.
This is the sixth consecutive month that the discount rate remained unchanged at an annual 33.74 percent.

NBY sets its discount rate each month using a basket that includes interest rates on the open money market and its short-term bonds, price rises, expected monetary developements, credit demand and money supply.

The discount rate, used as an instrument for regulating the amount of cash in circulation, was last cut in March after being kept steady at a monthly 4.5 percent since June 1996. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 311 4254
